products.notes: Excelon OEM-integration DSP amp (PASMAG review + Kenwood spec as quoted by retailers). 6 ch: 75 W @4 (<=1% THD+N), 100 W @2, 200 W x3 bridged @4. 10-channel 32-bit/192 kHz DSP: 6 amplified + 2 pairs DSP RCA outs. Input via 18-pin line-in / vehicle harness with iDatalink Maestro AR (no RCA inputs); input sensitivity 2.0-4.0 V. EQ: 13-band graphic or 3-band parametric per channel (PEQ 44 Hz-19.9 kHz, Q 0.4-8, -20/+6 dB). Delay up to 20 ft in 0.36 in steps (maxDelayMs 17.8 derived @343 m/s). X-over 6/12/18/24 dB/oct. S/N 95 dB (Kenwood page also shows 81 dBA CTA-2006). KENWOOD DSP CONTROL app (Bluetooth).
